dsp GenFoldTriGong4Even where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.8 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) / sr))
    let base := (1.0 - abs(ph * 4.0 - 2.0))
    let idx := 1.0 + (colour * 4.0 + 2.0) * ienvA
    let pre := (fold(base * idx) * envA) * 0.8
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7668

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>

    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))

    let idx := 1.0 + (colour * 7.0 + 3.5) * ienvA
    let pre := (fold(base * idx + 0.3) * envA) * 0.8
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7360

dsp GenFoldTriBass2Odd where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.6 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ienv : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let ienvA := select(trigger, gate, ienv * expneg(5.0 / (life * 0.3 * sr)))
    set ienv := ienvA
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * 0.5 / sr))
    let base := (1.0 - abs(ph * 4.0 - 2.0))
    let idx := 1.0 + (colour * 2.0 + 1.0) * ienvA
    let pre := (fold(base * idx + 0.3) * envA) * 0.8
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7706

    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 0.7412

dsp GenVoiceABassClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 680.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 977.5) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2465.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.2854

dsp GenVoiceABassBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 680.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 977.5) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2465.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.2843

dsp GenVoiceATenorClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 800.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1150.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2900.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3834

voiceATenorBreathy.source:
dsp GenVoiceATenorBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 800.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1150.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2900.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3804

dsp GenVoiceAAltoClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 896.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1288.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3248.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08

dsp GenVoiceAAltoBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0

    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)

    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)

    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))

    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 896.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))

    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a

    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1288.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1

dsp GenVoiceASopranoClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0

    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 960.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12

    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)

    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 340.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1360.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2295.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4088

  state i2a : F32 := 0.0

  state i2b : F32 := 0.0

    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))

    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))

    let ka := 0.12

    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a

    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1600.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2700.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c

    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c

dsp GenVoiceETenorBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 400.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1600.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2700.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.5418

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 448.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1792.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3024.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4810

dsp GenVoiceEAltoBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 448.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1792.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3024.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4769

dsp GenVoiceESopranoClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 480.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1920.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3240.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4634

dsp GenVoiceESopranoBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 480.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1920.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3240.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4494

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 520.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2080.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3510.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3550

dsp GenVoiceEChildBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 520.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2080.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3510.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3477

dsp GenVoiceIBassClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 229.5 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1819.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2507.5) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3629

dsp GenVoiceIBassBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 229.5 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1819.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2507.5) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3587

dsp GenVoiceITenorClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 270.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2140.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2950.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.2847

dsp GenVoiceITenorBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 270.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2140.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2950.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.2828

dsp GenVoiceIAltoClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 302.4 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2396.8) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3304.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3706

dsp GenVoiceIAltoBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 302.4 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2396.8) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3304.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3640

dsp GenVoiceISopranoClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 324.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2568.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3540.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4291

dsp GenVoiceISopranoBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 324.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2568.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3540.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4211

dsp GenVoiceIChildClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 351.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2782.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3835.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4608

voiceIChildBreathy.source:
dsp GenVoiceIChildBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state counter : F32 := 1.0
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(noise1(counter) * 437.5453 + counter * 0.6180339)
    set counter := select(gt(counter, 1000000.0), 1.0, counter + 1.0)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 351.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2782.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3835.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4585
